buyers_guide.q: What can a smart button do?
buyers_guide.a: Anything your hub can run: turn on a scene, toggle a lamp, start a routine, or arm an alarm. Many buttons recognize single, double, and long presses, so one button can run three actions.
Yes, for Zigbee and Z-Wave. The button sends a press to the hub, and the hub runs the automation. Some Zigbee buttons can bind directly to a bulb or plug, but most setups go through the hub.

buyers_guide.q: How long do the batteries last?
buyers_guide.a: Most battery sensors on these lists are rated for one to three years, depending on how often they report. Low-power radios like Zigbee, Z-Wave, and Thread last much longer than Wi-Fi.
